description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's behavior regarding packed refs management, including marking, verifying, and updating packed refs in a Git repository.

methods.name: mark_packed_refs
methods.description: Adds an identifying mark to the header line of the packed-refs file.

methods.name: check_packed_refs_marked
methods.description: Checks whether the packed-refs file is marked with the test-specific identifier.
